notes: runCommand is the single funnel for every mutation  so the append happens there after the flush -- the log can never claim a change the database does not have. Only undoable commands: logging page.open or history.undo would make a replay re-apply a navigation  or re-apply an undo as a change of mind. The test asserts a byte-identical prefix  which a row count would not catch.

Hard process kill (taskkill /F /T) mid-typing  not a graceful close  because a graceful close flushes and proves nothing. Asserts three things: the tree is still valid  the surviving text is a prefix of what was typed (a gap in the middle would mean the write interleaved with the typing)  and the loss is bounded at the tail.
